text: CRITICAL: Multi-vehicle pileup on Ahmedabad-Vadodara Expressway NE1 near Nadiad toll plaza! Bus and truck collided!
Severe crash on Expressway near Nadiad. Passengers trapped inside overturned bus. Traffic blocked!
108 Emergency Control: Dispatching 3 ALS Ambulances to Expressway NE1 KM 45 pileup. 6 critical casualties reported.
Hospital Trauma Alert: Red Alert declared. 8 incoming critical casualties from NE1 Expressway crash. Trauma bay cleared.
